title: Genitive Forms: Plural, -iden/-itten patterns review
focus: Retrieve the taught genitive patterns in a mixed review.
targetSkills: Plural genitive of one-syllable long-vowel words
Plural genitive of common diphthong words
Plural genitive of selected longer -o/-ö words

exercises.prompt: Recall the plural genitives in order, separated by a comma: maa (“country”); puu (“tree”).
exercises.explanation: Shorten aa to a and add -iden or -itten: maiden or maitten. These standard forms are all accepted: maiden, maitten. Shorten uu to u and add -iden or -itten: puiden or puitten. These standard forms are all accepted: puiden, puitten.
requiredSkills: Plural genitive of one-syllable long-vowel words
exercises.targetSkill: Plural genitive of one-syllable long-vowel words

exercises.prompt: Recall the plural genitives in order, separated by a comma: tie (“road”); yö (“night”).
exercises.explanation: Drop i from ie: tie → te-; add -iden or -itten. These standard forms are all accepted: teiden, teitten. Drop y from yö: yö → ö-; add -iden or -itten. These standard forms are all accepted: öiden, öitten.
requiredSkills: Plural genitive of common diphthong words
exercises.targetSkill: Plural genitive of common diphthong words
